title: Train Lookup

read.description: Read the training data for a Lookup Wrangle

write.description: Train a new or existing Lookup Wrangle

name.description: Name to give to a new Wrangle that will be created

model_id.description: Model to be updated. Either this or a name must be provided

variant.description: Variant of the Lookup Wrangle that will be created

action.description: Action to take when training the lookup wrangle

description: Read the training data for a Lookup Wrangle
guidance:
### Read #### Recipe ```yaml read: - train.lookup: model_id: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx ``` ##### Output
| Key | Value1 | Value2 | | :--- | :------ | :---- | | Pizza | Thin Crust | Deep Dish | | Hamburger | Single | Double | | Salad | Garden | Ceasar | | Taco | Soft | Crispy |
#### Function ```python from wrangles.connectors import train df = train.lookup.read(model_id = 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx') ``` ##### Output
| Key | Value1 | Value2 | | :--- | :------ | :---- | | Pizza | Thin Crust | Deep Dish | | Hamburger | Single | Double | | Salad | Garden | Ceasar | | Taco | Soft | Crispy |
### Write #### Recipe Update the training data for an existing lookup wrangle. ```yaml write: - train.lookup: model_id: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx ``` #### Function Create a new lookup wrangle. ```python from wrangles.connectors import train import pandas as pd df = pd.DataFrame({ 'Key': ['Pizza', 'Hamburger', 'Salad', 'Taco'], 'Value1': ['Thin Crust', 'Single', 'Garden', 'Soft'], 'Value2': ['Deep Dish', 'Double', 'Ceasar', 'Crispy'] }) train.lookup.write(df = df, name = 'Menu Updates', settings = {'variant': 'key'}) ``` > Note both name and model_id **cannot** be used together. Name is used when creating models and model_id is used when updating an existing model.
